implementation_status: Isolated original-runner launcher connected to reward hook; synthetic CPU original GRPO backward/optimizer verified. No live pilot, API scoring, Qwen/GPU training or test evaluation.

reward.token_scope: space-joined visible Agent replies in the complete existing terminal conversation; excludes private assessment and Doctor messages
reward.interactivity_scope: visible Doctor-Agent discussion excluding FINAL, private assessment, hidden status, system prompts, gold and outcome
reward.unparsed_final_policy: exclude from all training reward components exactly like outcome-only; no valid descendants => reward null
reward.judge_failure_policy: record attempt; bounded transport retries; invalid score aborts and is not cached or zero-filled

future_reward_estimator.terminal_set: exact original leaves with non-null outcome
future_reward_estimator.aggregation: equal weight per existing valid descendant leaf, no depth/path-probability reweighting
future_reward_estimator.interactivity_cache: one judgment per identical visible input and pinned judge/prompt/params identity, reused across leaves/ancestors/resume; do not deduplicate leaves in reward denominator
future_reward_estimator.reuse_scope: current frozen on-policy batch trees; never replay another trained policy tree for an on-policy update

length_weight_pilot.policy: verified initial adapter, no optimizer updates
length_weight_pilot.selection: inspect train distributions; record chosen nonnegative lambda and rationale; no automatic default
length_weight_pilot.freeze: immutable artifact containing full pilot, hashes, model/prompt identity, lambda and timestamp before viewing test results
length_weight_pilot.pilot_tree_reuse: reuse same initial batch tree and cached judgments for first training update
length_weight_pilot.expansion_cost: 15 or 45 additional initial-policy case trees relative to reusing first batch only; audit separately, never replay expansion trees after policy update

final_evaluation: only final checkpoint after 120 cases; no intermediate test jobs or test-driven selection
